scope: Both triangles and parallelograms of equal perpendicular height; no shared-side restriction.
derivation: Perpendicular foot and Gram identity imply determinant squared = base squared times altitude squared.
Unsigned triangle area and positive lengths imply 2*area=base*height.
Equal positive heights cancel to give equal area/base quotients.
Transport to the existing equimultiple ratio interface; parallelogram area is twice its diagonal triangle area.
boundary: Height is independently defined by perpendicular feet, never area/base. Numeric positive-real measures only. No standalone Book V extension.
status: First geometric prerequisite prepared; source proposition not yet complete.
